overview: This file documents U.S. scrutiny of Japanese finances from 1940 to 1941. Extensive translated budgets detail military spending, borrowing, special accounts, and overseas administrations. Diplomatic correspondence and FBI reports track trade credits, gold shipments, bank accounts, bond schemes, and efforts to restrict financing for Japanese interests.
interest: Detailed budget schedules paired with banking investigations reveal both Japanese spending priorities and U.S. monitoring of wartime finance.
